newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse mixed after U.S. jobless data.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse mixed after U.S. jobless data.

text.p: French shares traded mixed after the release of unchanged U.S. jobless claims data. The market had reduced its gains to a small 0.36 percent just before the data and posted small gains after the data was released before slipping again. Opinion poll rumours about Sunday's election keeping investors on their toes.
* CAC-40 index up 7.37, or 0.29 percent, at 2,590.54 at 1231 GMT
* CAC-40 May futures 2,589 vs 2,579 at Wednesday's close.
* CAC-40 Total volume was a brisk 4.6 billion francs. (c) Reuters Limited 1997
